source.author: ov
source.text: Haec quoque ut haud poterat, spatio submota, videri, vela tamen spectat summo fluitantia malo; ut nec vela videt, vacuum petit anxia lectum seque toro ponit; renovat lectusque locusque Alcyonae lacrimas et, quae pars, admonet, absit.
source.text_original: Haec quoque ut haud poterat, spatio submota, videri, / vela tamen spectat summo fluitantia malo; / ut nec vela videt, vacuum petit anxia lectum / seque toro ponit; renovat lectusque locusque / Alcyonae lacrimas et, quae pars, admonet, absit.
source.text_english: And though this too, being removed by distance, could not be seen, still she gazes at the sails fluttering from the top of the mast; and when she can no longer see the sails, she anxiously seeks the empty bed and lays herself on the couch. The bed and the place renew Alcyone’s tears, and the part that is missing reminds her.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: excussi manibus remi, conversaque frontem puppis in oblicum resonos latus accipit ictus, vela super tremulum subitus volitantia malum turbo rapit.
reuse.text_original: excussi manibus remi, conversaque frontem / puppis in oblicum resonos latus accipit ictus, / vela super tremulum subitus volitantia malum / turbo rapit.
reuse.text_english: The oars were struck from their hands, and the ship, its prow turned askew, receives the echoing blows on its side; then a sudden whirlwind snatches the sails, fluttering above, from the trembling mast.
